notes.title: Attack-Move, Sound Contacts, and more!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! A new update has arrived!

This update includes the following - 

The outline of friendly unit icons will now pulse red if that squad/vehicle is under fire. Allows you to more easily see which of your units are being attacked.

You can now double right click to order infantry to run to the target position. Once they reach their destination, they will return to their original stance.

Attack-Move has been added. You can toggle between regular move (the default movement) and Attack-Move with the designated button or the hotkey (F by default). With regular move, units will ignore enemy units (except vehicles with a turret, which are able to attack while moving). With Attack-Move, units will stop and attack any enemies they can on their way to the destination.

The Attack-Move button replaced the Unit Icons button. You can still use the hotkey to disable/enable unit icons.

Sound Contacts - An icon with a question mark will show above the position of enemy units that are close enough but that you don't have Line-Of-Sight to. The sound contact distance varies depending on the unit type, whether it's moving, and if it's shooting. Infantry are able to detect sound contacts better than vehicles.

Elite infantry now lose less morale than regular infantry when suppressed or out of energy. Previously they only lost less morale when losing friendly units.

Fixed a bug that sometimes made a battle not load correctly.

Fixed other small bugs.

Have a great Memorial Day weekend!

notes.title: Tactical Pause and Queued Movements are now in the game!
notes.content:
Hi, thank you everyone for all the great feedback you have provided!

The first update since release includes the following - 

Tactical Pause - You can now press the Tactical Pause hotkey (Spacebar by default) to pause the game in a battle. In this mode you can still freely move the camera, give commands to units, and deploy new units. This was a much requested feature, so let me know how it's working for you guys!

Queued Movements - If you hold the Left Shift key you can que multiple movement orders in a row. This makes it nice if you want your units to follow a specific path.

Those were the two big things, there are a couple smaller things included in the update as well - 

Scout infantry (Sniper, Recon, Scharfschütze, and Aufklärer) no longer have a detection penalty when moving. This means whether they are idle or moving makes no difference in how easy they are to spot.

AI deployment speed was very slightly slowed down. I still plan to improve this further.

Enemy icons will now fade out if the enemy unit is no longer detected. Previously, the icon would immediately disappear.

That's all! Thanks for playing, and I hope to keep on receiving more feedback!

notes.title: Battlefield Commander WWII is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce Battlefield Commander WWII is now available in Early Access!

Here's what's changed since the last demo release -

New UI art
New map "Dukla Pass"
Improved AI strategy in Battle and Flag modes
Unit vision is slightly decreased overall
LOS bar will show when hovering over enemy unit even if the tool isn't enabled
Added "hit” effect and sound effect for tanks when they get damaged
Lowered Mortar rate of fire
Fixed some SFX that weren't playing correctly
Fixed gun vehicles now obey attack orders correctly
Disabled gamepad and joystick input
Added option to change graphics and resolution while in battle from the pause menu

If you decide to get the game, we would really appreciate a review as well! They help a lot!

See you on the battlefield, commander!

notes.title: Release Stream
notes.content: Release stream! This was a pre-recorded battle. Sorry about the two missing flag icons on the minimap, that has been fixed!

notes.title: Battlefield Commander WWII Enters Early Access on April 7th!
notes.content:
Attention, commanders! The wait is almost over—Battlefield Commander WWII is launching into Early Access on April 7th!

This is just the beginning—future updates will bring new units, maps, nations, multiplayer, and more features based on player feedback.

Mark your calendars, rally your troops, and prepare for war. April 7th is your chance to take command. Are you ready to lead your forces to victory?

notes.title: New demo update!
notes.content:
Hi, a new update for the demo has been published! It contains the following -

You can now right click on enemy icons to target them!

The previous "Hide" ability has been re-worked to be a Hold Fire/Fire at Will system. You can now move units that have been set to Hold Fire.

SMG infantry (except recon and units that have a Panzerfaust) are now equipped with an anti tank grenade. These will automatically be used against any enemy vehicle that comes within 30 meters of the SMG unit. Infantry can still use AP grenades against open top vehicles.

Units now display a "Panicking" icon above them when they are panicking.

Changed how deployed units are listed. They are now shown on the left side of the screen, separated into infantry and armor. You can hide or show the lists depending on your preference.

Added a tooltip when you hover over a unit purchase button. It now displays information on the unit so you can better choose what you want to buy.

Added a scrollbar to the armor section for unit purchasing. We want to make sure players know they can scroll down the armor units list to see more options!

Improved vehicle targeting priority. Vehicles will now attempt to target a unit that attacks them.

Improved camera rotation with the mouse wheel. It should be much smoother now!

Updated the tutorial to be up to date with the latest changes.

Fixed some issues with individual sound effects.

A lot of these changes came from player feedback, which we are really grateful for! Please let us know if you have your own feedback! Thanks!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we just released a new update for the demo! It includes the following - 

Fixed bugs with sound effects, including sounds previously not coming from the right direction.

Added engine and track sound effects to all vehicles. No more silent tanks!

Vehicles will now move in reverse if ordered to move behind them within 25 meters.

You can hold down the right mouse button to choose a facing direction when ordering units to move.

Game will now correctly pause when pressing the escape key in a battle.

Small improvements to Post Battle Report for dynamic campaign.

Other bug fixes.

Some of these came about directly from feedback we received, so thank you! Keep it coming!

See you on the battlefield commander!

notes.title: Battlefield Commander WWII Gameplay Stream
notes.content: A recent battle on the Tannenberg Line map we recorded. Playing as the Soviet Union against the Germans in Flags mode on Regular difficulty.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Demo update
notes.content:
Hi, we are happy to announce our latest update to the demo!

Included in the latest update is the following: 

Dynamic Campaign! We are really excited to have this as part of the current demo! You can now play Dynamic Campaign as either the Germans or the Soviet Union. Everything should work, but things may change a little in the future.

A new map! Tannenberg Line is a new fully featured map that you can play Battle mode, Flags mode, and in Dynamic Campaign!

AI now has better priority targeting (tanks and armored cars will prioritize targeting enemy tanks and vehicles over infantry).

Optimizations for better performance, including a new option to change your in-game resolution.

Other small improvements and bug fixes.

We will be participating in the Steam Next Fest starting on Monday, so it's a great time to try out the demo! We are always ready for any feedback you have! Let us know!

notes.title: Update and Real-Time Strategy Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We have published a new update to the demo! Included in the update is the following - 
Tutorial - the game now has a short tutorial explaining the controls and mechanics of gameplay!
Unit icons have been updated for both player and enemy units!
Vehicles now have different components that can be damaged (tracks, gun, ammo rack, turret).
Lots of other small fixes and improvements.

We are also happy to be part of the Real-Time Strategy Fest!

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: A new update for the demo is now live! It includes the ability to rotate the camera with your mouse wheel button and also adds icons above the enemy AI units for better visibility. This may be updated further in the future. Another modification was making "Elite" difficulty a little bit easier (AI gets 75% more RP's instead of 100% more). Let us know what you guys think!

notes.title: Demo is now live!
notes.content: Hi everyone, the demo for Battlefield Commander WWII is now live! You can immediately download the game and play! We welcome all feedback, so let us know what you think! See you on the Battlefield!

notes.title: Battlefield Commander WWII Reveal Trailer Released
notes.content: Hi commanders! Today we are excited to release the reveal trailer for Battlefield Commander WWII! We continue to work steadily and are happy to announce we'll be participating in the October 2024 Steam Next Fest! We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!
